description: Ethernet micro controller with 8 digital inputs, 8 digital outputs and 4 configurable DIO channels (Click&Go logic)
source: Moxa, "ioLogik E2200 Series User Manual", version 7.2 (July 2022), Appendix I

sources.title: ioLogik E2200 Series User Manual
sources.note: Appendix I, ioLogik E2212 Modbus mapping

notes: Modbus/TCP address map from Appendix I of the manual. Many values appear twice, as a coil or discrete input and again as a holding register (names ending in "(register)").
32-bit values are two registers; the manual lists the high word first unless the register says otherwise.
Not in this map: the DI counter mode values at holding 0x0D00, which the manual lists as two-word values at consecutive addresses.
